title: Significance of Chain of Thought in Gender Bias Mitigation for English-Dravidian Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Translating gender-neutral English sentences from Politics, Sports, and Profession domains into Telugu and Kannada using Google Translate and ChatGPT, and utilizing human expert evaluation to calculate the percentage of translations that default to gender-specific (often masculine) inflections based on societal stereotypes. The study also measures the effectiveness of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting in mitigating this bias.
